title: Hero's Journey Interactive Map
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Click-to-explore circular map of the 11 stages of Campbell's Hero's Journey, each translated into a stage of a customer's buying journey, followed by a three-question comprehension check.

learningObjectives: Explain the stages of the Hero's Journey and how they apply to sales storytelling.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a B2B sales cycle

keyQuestions: Explain the stages of the Hero's Journey and how they apply to sales storytelling.
commonMisconceptions: The Hero's Journey is only for epic myths.
All stages must appear in every story.
assessmentOpportunities: Learner identifies the Call to Adventure as the customer recognizing a problem.
Learner identifies the customer, not the seller, as the hero.
Learner maps a pilot agreement to Crossing the Threshold.
